meta.task: P1 middleware/API speed and dead-code audit

sources.api_routes: automated pattern scan across all 27 API route files

key_themes: Missing caching headers on 24/27 API routes
Inconsistent error handling (only 3 routes use ApiErrorHandler)
9 unused npm dependencies costing bundle size
Middleware matcher misses Next.js data fetches

middleware.description: Matcher config misses `_next/data` (client-side data fetches), `_next/webpack-hmr`, fonts, CSS, JS, .json, .xml, .txt files — every client-side page transition runs middleware unnecessarily
middleware.recommendation: Add `_next/data` and additional static extensions to matcher exclusion pattern

middleware.description: createServerClient is constructed on every request including public pages (/about, /contact, etc.) even when no auth cookie exists. The fast-path skips getUser() but the client is still created
middleware.recommendation: Move createServerClient construction behind the auth-cookie check for non-API routes

middleware.description: Missing CORP (Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy), COOP (Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy), and Cache-Control security headers. CSP uses unsafe-eval and unsafe-inline (required for Next.js but worth documenting)
Promise.race timeout in withTimeout() never aborts the underlying Supabase fetch — TCP connections leak on timeout. The timeoutId! non-null assertion is also fragile
middleware.recommendation: Use AbortController to cancel the fetch on timeout

middleware.description: cookies.getAll() called 4 times per request; getProjectFingerprint() is unmemoized (URL parsing on every request)
middleware.recommendation: Memoize getProjectFingerprint() and reuse cookie list

middleware.description: Invalid-refresh-token cleanup code duplicated across error branch (lines 212-228) and exception branch (lines 233-247)

api_routes.description: 24 of 27 API routes return no Cache-Control headers — responses are never cached by CDN or browser. Only health, maps/proxy-script, and maps/metro-boundaries set cache headers
api_routes.recommendation: Add Cache-Control headers to all GET endpoints; use 'public, max-age=N' for cacheable data, 'no-cache' for user-specific data

api_routes.description: Only 3 of 27 routes use the centralized ApiErrorHandler (interactions, users/avatar, interactions/reset). All other routes use raw NextResponse.json() with inline error shapes — inconsistent error format across API surface
api_routes.recommendation: Standardize on ApiErrorHandler for all routes or document the intentional divergence

api_routes.description: 19 of 27 API routes have no rate limiting. Admin cron-secret routes are unprotected by rate limit (5 routes). Several user-facing POST endpoints also lack rate limiting
api_routes.recommendation: Apply rate limiting to all POST/PUT/DELETE endpoints; admin routes should also have rate limits even with cron-secret

api_routes.description: Only 6 of 27 routes use Zod for input validation. Several POST endpoints accept JSON bodies without validation
api_routes.recommendation: Add Zod schemas to all POST/PUT/PATCH endpoints that accept JSON bodies

api_routes.description: Only 4 routes implement timeouts for external calls (couples/activity, couples/mutual-likes, interactions/reset, interactions). Admin routes doing Zillow API calls and OpenAI calls have no timeout protection
api_routes.recommendation: Add timeouts to all routes that make external API calls (Zillow, OpenAI, Google Maps)

api_routes.description: Only 5 routes include performance tracking (startTime/Date.now() in response). No consistent latency monitoring
api_routes.recommendation: Add consistent performance tracking via withPerformanceTracking wrapper

api_routes.description: 8 routes lack explicit 405 Method Not Allowed handlers for unsupported HTTP methods — in test environments, calling wrong method may hang
api_routes.recommendation: Add explicit 405 handlers for all routes, especially those tested in E2E/Playwright

dead_code.description: 9 npm production dependencies imported nowhere in src/: zustand, posthog-js, posthog-node, @sentry/nextjs, @ai-sdk/openai, ai, @tanstack/react-query-devtools, inngest, express-rate-limit
dead_code.recommendation: Remove from package.json to reduce bundle size and install time

dead_code.description: 3 server actions in src/lib/supabase/actions.ts (login, signup, signInWithGoogle) are exported but never imported — forms use Supabase client directly
dead_code.recommendation: Remove dead server actions or wire them into auth forms

dead_code.description: authRateLimit exported from src/lib/middleware/rateLimiter.ts but never called — duplicate rate-limiting infrastructure
dead_code.recommendation: Remove authRateLimit; consolidate on single rate-limiting approach

dead_code.description: callRPC in src/lib/services/supabase-rpc-types.ts is a duplicate of the real RPC wrapper in utils/rpc-wrapper.ts — dead export
createZillowClient factory exported but never imported — dead factory pattern
5 test-only exports in production code: __withRefreshRecovery (x2), __isMissingSupabaseConfigError, __resetSecureMapLoaderStateForTests, resetRateLimitStore
dead_code.recommendation: Move behind NODE_ENV guard or into test utils directory

dead_code.description: CouplesMiddleware class exported but never instantiated anywhere in codebase
dead_code.recommendation: Remove or wire into route handlers

dead_code.description: 3 geo-selection utilities (convexHull, polygonCentroid, isPointInPolygon) only used in tests, not in production code
dead_code.recommendation: Move to test utils or remove

dead_code.description: Two parallel rate-limiting systems: withRateLimit (middleware/rateLimiter.ts) and apiRateLimiter (utils/rate-limit.ts) — most routes use one or the other, not both
dead_code.recommendation: Consolidate on a single rate-limiting approach

dead_code.description: ~15 coordinate conversion utilities in coordinates.ts never imported in production code
dead_code.recommendation: Audit and remove unused coordinate utilities

dead_code.description: Stale TODO markers in neighborhood.ts related to caching and error handling

prioritized_actions.action: Fix middleware matcher to exclude _next/data and static assets
Remove 9 unused npm dependencies from package.json
Add Cache-Control headers to all GET API endpoints
Add CORP and COOP security headers to middleware
Add rate limiting to unprotected POST endpoints and admin routes
Standardize error handling on ApiErrorHandler or remove it
Add timeouts to admin routes doing external API calls
Remove dead server actions (login, signup, signInWithGoogle)
